scope: Shared player, opponent and delegated-fighter body control and supported footwork in the existing playable match
design_authority: User correction: behind-and-above gameplay camera; foundation overview is not absolute
changes: Authored native slips, ducks, pulls and weaves feed continuous body intent, support and effort on both fighters; head and torso queries no longer add a second legacy offset.
Opponent authored moves, neutral approach, orbit and range decisions request bounded physical steps with stamina cost, planted support and recovery instead of direct root translation.

Native player legacy move/sprint commands cannot add free travel. Existing delegated profile decisions translate to supported steps, preserving their range bands, defense requests and clinch cue taps.
Opponent punches begun during entry carry the shared STEPPING modifier and telegraph; no second lunge.
AI holds a small range tolerance instead of spending full step cost on centimetre shuffles.
Zero opponent clock preserves queued intent; old tween snapshots migrate only remaining distance capped at one step; interrupted steps cannot resume after a count or clinch.
